name: Home Assistant — Sensor
description: One or more Home Assistant entities as bold value blocks — six Bauhaus / Swiss visual directions to choose from. A single entity fills the cell as a hero number; several lay out as a 3×2 tile grid. Requires the Home Assistant Core plugin.

cell_options.name: overrides
cell_options.label: Per-entity name / icon overrides
cell_options.help:
One entity per line, pipe-separated: ``entity_id | name | icon``. Either the name or the icon can be left empty to keep the auto value. Icon is a Phosphor name (see phosphoricons.com), without the ``ph-`` prefix. Lines starting with ``#`` are comments.

Example:
sensor.living_room_temperature | Living Room | thermometer-simple
sensor.bedroom_temperature | Bedroom |
sensor.solar_power | | sun
